sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Detroit, Michigan is the home to the Ambassador Bridge,
sentences.zh: 密歇根州底特律市坐落着大使桥，

sentences.en: which links Detroit to the Canadian border city of Windsor.
sentences.zh: 它连接着底特律与加拿大边境城市温莎。

sentences.en: The ambassador is essential.
sentences.zh: 这座大使桥至关重要。

sentences.en: CNN once called it the most economically important
sentences.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）曾称其为

sentences.en: one and a half miles of roadway in the Western Hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 西半球经济意义最重要的一英里半道路。

sentences.en: Every day, endless lines of trucks wait for hours on a concrete plaza
sentences.zh: 每天，无数卡车在混凝土广场上排起长龙，等待数小时，

sentences.en: flanked by rows of traffic cones
sentences.zh: 两侧摆满了交通锥，

sentences.en: so they can be processed by a border agent.
sentences.zh: 以便接受边境人员的检查。

sentences.en: That's producer Andrew Lapin.
sentences.zh: 那是制片人安德鲁·拉平。

sentences.en: The ambassador is the linchpin of the North American auto industry.
sentences.zh: 大使桥是北美汽车工业的枢纽。

sentences.en: Cars are constantly being driven back and forth to different factories.
sentences.zh: 汽车不断地在不同工厂之间往返运输。

sentences.en: Last year, more than 2 million trucks drove across the ambassador.
sentences.zh: 去年，超过200万辆卡车驶过了大使桥。

sentences.en: In fact, 30% of all trade between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 事实上，美国与加拿大之间30%的贸易额

sentences.en: and Canada rolls over this bridge.
sentences.zh: 都是通过这座桥完成的。

sentences.en: Everybody has to use the bridge because they basically don't have any other choice.
sentences.zh: 每个人都必须使用这座桥，因为他们基本上别无选择。

sentences.en: There's a tunnel nearby that's too small for most trucks to drive through.
sentences.zh: 附近虽然有一条隧道，但对大多数卡车来说太小了，无法通行。

sentences.en: And the next closest international bridge is some 65 miles away.
sentences.zh: 而最近的另一座国际大桥远在约65英里之外。

sentences.en: To get to the bridge, all those freight trucks first have to drive by a residential neighborhood in southwest Detroit called Mexican Town.
sentences.zh: 为了到达大桥，所有货运卡车首先必须经过底特律西南部一个叫“墨西哥城”的居民区。

sentences.en: And for many years, they had to drive right through it.
sentences.zh: 多年来，它们不得不直接穿过该区域。

sentences.en: Mexican Town is right at the bridge's entry point.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥城就在大桥的入口处。

sentences.en: And residents have suffered through loud honking and negative health effects for decades.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，居民们饱受刺耳的鸣笛声和健康受损的困扰。

sentences.en: Here's how Sam Butler, president of a local neighborhood group
sentences.zh: 当地一个社区组织的主席萨姆·巴特勒是这样

sentences.en: Described it to me
sentences.zh: 向我描述的：

sentences.en: There is this like black soot on like windows
sentences.zh: 窗户上有一层黑色的煤灰，

sentences.en: Or on the outside of people's homes that face the bridge
sentences.zh: 或者在人们面向大桥的房屋外墙上，

sentences.en: That you can like literally take your finger
sentences.zh: 你可以用手指，

sentences.en: Wipe off a piece of this black soot
sentences.zh: 直接擦掉一块这种黑色的煤灰。

sentences.en: Living so close to a international crossing
sentences.zh: 生活在这样一个国际过境点附近，

sentences.en: That gets 10,000 trucks per day
sentences.zh: 每天有1万辆卡车经过，

sentences.en: Folks in Windsor don't like the bridge either
sentences.zh: 温莎的居民也不喜欢这座桥。

sentences.en: It's not well maintained
sentences.zh: 它维护得并不好。

sentences.en: Large chunks of concrete have been known to break off
sentences.zh: 众所周知，大块的混凝土经常脱落，

sentences.en: and fall on the streets below.
sentences.zh: 掉落在下方的街道上。

sentences.en: Basically, everyone in the surrounding area hates this bridge,
sentences.zh: 基本上，周边地区的所有人都讨厌这座桥，

sentences.en: but they have nobody to complain to.
sentences.zh: 但他们投诉无门。

sentences.en: They can't petition the city or the county
sentences.zh: 他们无法向市政府、县政府，

sentences.en: or even the U.S.
sentences.zh: 甚至美国政府，

sentences.en: or Canadian governments
sentences.zh: 或加拿大政府请愿，

sentences.en: because none of them own this bridge.
sentences.zh: 因为他们谁都不拥有这座桥。

sentences.en: In fact, for the longest time,
sentences.zh: 事实上，在很长一段时间里，

sentences.en: the Ambassador Bridge was owned by one guy.
sentences.zh: 大使桥一直由一个人拥有。

sentences.en: You had to take it up with him if you could get a hold of him.
sentences.zh: 如果你能联系上他，就得找他交涉。

sentences.en: I'm a quiet private man,
sentences.zh: “我是一个安静、低调的人，

sentences.en: But somebody decided to make me something other than being private.
sentences.zh: 但有人决定让我变得不再低调。”

sentences.en: I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: That's Manuel Maroon.
sentences.zh: 那是曼努埃尔·马伦。

sentences.en: He went by Matty.
sentences.zh: 他叫马蒂。

sentences.en: He owned the Ambassador Bridge from 1979 until 2018,
sentences.zh: 他从1979年到2018年一直拥有大使桥，

sentences.en: when the ownership transferred to his son, Matthew.
sentences.zh: 之后所有权转让给了他的儿子马修。

sentences.en: The elder Maroon may have been private,
sentences.zh: 老马伦可能确实很低调，

sentences.en: in the sense that he almost never gave interviews.
sentences.zh: 因为他几乎从不接受采访。

sentences.en: But for decades, he was, quietly, one of the most important people in Detroit.
sentences.zh: 但几十年来，他一直悄无声息地成为底特律最重要的人物之一。

sentences.en: When Manny Maroon died in 2020, he was a billionaire.
sentences.zh: 曼尼·马伦于2020年去世时，已是一位亿万富翁。

sentences.en: A good chunk of his empire was funded with bridge tolls and the duty-free gas stations on the bridge.
sentences.zh: 他的商业帝国很大一部分资金来源于过桥费和桥上的免税加油站。

sentences.en: By this point, you're probably asking the obvious question.
sentences.zh: 说到这，你可能已经在问那个显而易见的问题了。

sentences.en: How can one man and his family own an international bridge, a critical piece of infrastructure that so many people have to use?
sentences.zh: 一个人及其家族怎么能拥有一座国际大桥，这一如此多人必须使用的关键基础设施？

sentences.en: Actually, a lot of critical infrastructure is privately owned.
sentences.zh: 事实上，许多关键基础设施都是私有的。

sentences.en: And the story of the Maroon family in Detroit shows how this kind of relationship can go totally wrong.
sentences.zh: 而底特律马伦家族的故事展示了这种关系是如何彻底失控的。

sentences.en: The Ambassador Bridge has always been privately owned.
sentences.zh: 大使桥一直以来都是私有的。

sentences.en: And when it was built in the 1920s, that wasn't so unusual.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪20年代建造时，这并不罕见。

sentences.en: At the time, the economy was booming and the country was modernizing.
sentences.zh: 当时经济繁荣，国家正在现代化。

sentences.en: But local governments were often slow to act.
sentences.zh: 但地方政府往往行动迟缓。

sentences.en: So big infrastructure projects, like bridges, sometimes needed private investors to get off the ground.
sentences.zh: 因此，像桥梁这样的大型基础设施项目，有时需要私人投资者来启动。

sentences.en: In Detroit, the auto industry was taking off,
sentences.zh: 在底特律，汽车工业正在兴起，

sentences.en: but there was no easy way to get parts across the river from Canada.
sentences.zh: 但没有简单的方法将零部件从加拿大运过河。

sentences.en: They needed a bridge.
sentences.zh: 他们需要一座桥。

sentences.en: The city and the state weren't building one,
sentences.zh: 市政府和州政府没有建造，

sentences.en: so private investors started raising money and drawing up plans.
sentences.zh: 所以私人投资者开始筹集资金并制定计划。

sentences.en: I should add, the mayor of Detroit at the time
sentences.zh: 我应该补充一点，当时的底特律市长

sentences.en: did not like the idea that this bridge would be privately owned.
sentences.zh: 并不喜欢这座桥由私人拥有的想法。

sentences.en: He tried to stop it.
sentences.zh: 他试图阻止它。

sentences.en: But after the city passed a ballot proposal by a huge margin,
sentences.zh: 但在城市以巨大优势通过投票提案后，

sentences.en: he had no choice.
sentences.zh: 他别无选择。

sentences.en: The stakes were driven into the ground in 1927.
sentences.zh: 1927年，大桥动工。

sentences.en: At a ceremony to mark the occasion,
sentences.zh: 在纪念这一时刻的仪式上，

sentences.en: a 16-year-old girl in high heels
sentences.zh: 一位穿着高跟鞋的16岁女孩

sentences.en: bounced across a catwalk over the Detroit River.
sentences.zh: 在横跨底特律河的猫道上蹦蹦跳跳。

sentences.en: This girl, Helen Austin,
sentences.zh: 这个女孩叫海伦·奥斯汀，

sentences.en: was the daughter of one of the bridge's original investors.
sentences.zh: 是大桥最初投资者之一的女儿。

sentences.en: Reports at the time said
sentences.zh: 当时的报道称，

sentences.en: she was the first person to walk across the river.
sentences.zh: 她是第一个步行过河的人。

sentences.en: Here's what one local newspaper wrote that day.
sentences.zh: 当地一家报纸当天是这样写的：

sentences.en: To the clouds of dark brown smoke
sentences.zh: “在那升腾于铁路之上的

sentences.en: that rose above the railroad,
sentences.zh: 深褐色烟云中，

sentences.en: one could vision a mighty steel structure
sentences.zh: 人们可以预见一座宏伟的钢铁结构，

sentences.en: of greater clearance than the Brooklyn Bridge,
sentences.zh: 比布鲁克林大桥拥有更高的净空，

sentences.en: spanning the Detroit River
sentences.zh: 横跨底特律河，

sentences.en: and opening a new era in continental transportation.
sentences.zh: 开启了大陆交通的新纪元。”

sentences.en: But the celebrations were short-lived.
sentences.zh: 但庆祝活动转瞬即逝。

sentences.en: The ambassador struggled after the Great Depression
sentences.zh: 大萧条后，大使桥陷入困境，

sentences.en: and for years had financial probleMs.
sentences.zh: 多年来一直存在财务问题。

sentences.en: The owners managed to keep it open
sentences.zh: 业主们设法维持了它的运营，

sentences.en: by making the bridge into a publicly traded company
sentences.zh: 将大桥变成了一家上市公司，

sentences.en: with shares available on the stock market.
sentences.zh: 并在股票市场上发行了股票。

sentences.en: For a time, this approach helped keep the bridge solvent.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，这种方法帮助大桥保持了偿付能力。

sentences.en: But ultimately, the decision to sell shares opened the door to a takeover by one man,
sentences.zh: 但最终，出售股票的决定为一个人接管大桥打开了大门，

sentences.en: a man nobody in Detroit had ever really heard of.
sentences.zh: 一个底特律没人听说过的人。

sentences.en: His basic biography ought to be that of Rags to Riches' American hero.
sentences.zh: 他的人生轨迹本应是典型的美国式“白手起家”英雄故事。

sentences.en: And instead, he's probably the most disliked businessman in Detroit by far in a couple of generations.
sentences.zh: 然而相反，他可能是底特律几代人中最不受欢迎的商人。

sentences.en: That's John Gallagher.
sentences.zh: 那是约翰·加拉格尔。

sentences.en: He's a retired Detroit Free Press journalist and one of the only people to have ever interviewed Maroon, who really was a self-made success.
sentences.zh: 他是《底特律自由报》的退休记者，也是极少数采访过马伦的人之一，马伦确实是一位白手起家的成功人士。

sentences.en: Maroon started working in his dad's garage after college and tenaciously grew that into a local trucking empire.
sentences.zh: 马伦大学毕业后开始在他父亲的车库工作，并顽强地将其发展成了一个当地的卡车运输帝国。

sentences.en: Matty told me during one of the few times when he was talking to reporters that as a teenager, he had pumped gas for Jimmy Hoffa.
sentences.zh: 马蒂在为数不多与记者交谈的几次中告诉我，他十几岁时曾为吉米·霍法加过油。

sentences.en: And, you know, built, you know, came from sort of rags to riches, built this enormous fortune, mainly through his trucking company.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他白手起家，建立了一个巨大的财富帝国，主要靠的是他的卡车运输公司。

sentences.en: Matty Maroon outbid some fierce competition, including from Warren Buffett, to get total ownership of the bridge.
sentences.zh: 马蒂·马伦击败了包括沃伦·巴菲特在内的激烈竞争对手，获得了大桥的完全所有权。

sentences.en: Matty Maroon actually had a long history with the ambassador before he purchased it.
sentences.zh: 其实在购买大使桥之前，马蒂·马伦与它就有着很深的渊源。

sentences.en: His family had been pushed out of their home by the original construction project.
sentences.zh: 他的家人曾因最初的建设项目而被赶出家园。

sentences.en: But 50 years later, the bridge was all his.
sentences.zh: 但50年后，这座桥完全属于他了。

sentences.en: Basically, a license to print money.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这就是一张印钞许可证。

sentences.en: You have a family-controlled private company of scale, right, that, you know, you do the math,
sentences.zh: 你拥有一个规模化的家族控制的私营公司，对吧，你知道，算算账，

sentences.en: but they must have been turning millions and millions of dollars of unbelievable profit from this asset.
sentences.zh: 他们一定从这个资产中获得了数百万美元令人难以置信的利润。

sentences.en: This is Steve Tabachman, a former Democratic Michigan state representative from southwest Detroit.
sentences.zh: 这是史蒂夫·塔巴赫曼，前民主党密歇根州众议员，来自底特律西南部。

sentences.en: He says after Matty Maroon bought the bridge in 1979, he became a notorious figure in the community.
sentences.zh: 他说，马蒂·马伦在1979年买下大桥后，成了社区里的一个臭名昭著的人物。

sentences.en: Describing every shenanigan Matty Maroon got up to in Detroit would take hours.
sentences.zh: 描述马蒂·马伦在底特律搞的所有勾当需要几个小时。

sentences.en: I'm not going to do that.
sentences.zh: 我不会那样做。

sentences.en: But Baseline, according to Tabachman, Maroon didn't do very much to address the longstanding complaints about noise and dirt in the neighborhoods near the bridge.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，据塔巴赫曼所说，马伦并没有做太多事情来解决大桥附近社区长期存在的噪音和灰尘投诉。

sentences.en: In fact, there wasn't much community outreach at all.
sentences.zh: 事实上，几乎没有任何社区外联活动。

sentences.en: There was no presence for this company in the community
sentences.zh: 这家公司在社区里没有任何存在感，

sentences.en: other than the commerce they were doing.
sentences.zh: 除了他们所从事的商业活动。

sentences.en: So there weren't large investments.
sentences.zh: 所以没有大规模的投资。

sentences.en: There wasn't like there was a Manny Maroon community center
sentences.zh: 没有所谓的曼尼·马伦社区中心，

sentences.en: or rec center or, you know, reading room at the high school
sentences.zh: 或者娱乐中心，或者，你知道，高中的阅览室，

sentences.en: or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 或者类似的东西。

sentences.en: Detroit's wealthiest businessmen have tended to give a lot to local charities,
sentences.zh: 底特律最富有的商人们往往会向当地慈善机构捐赠大量资金，

sentences.en: especially when the city started losing people in the mid-20th century.
sentences.zh: 特别是在20世纪中期城市开始人口流失的时候。

sentences.en: But Matty Maroon wasn't a big public philanthropiSt.
sentences.zh: 但马蒂·马伦并不是一个热衷于公共慈善的人。

sentences.en: He was more focused on expanding the bridge empire.
sentences.zh: 他更专注于扩张他的大桥帝国。

sentences.en: In the 1980s, Maroon bought up a bunch of land near the bridge.
sentences.zh: 20世纪80年代，马伦买下了大桥附近的一大片土地。

sentences.en: Then he presented a plan to expand the ambassador's entryway, the opening plaza.
sentences.zh: 然后他提出了一个扩建大使桥入口处，即开放广场的计划。

sentences.en: This expansion was so the bridge could accommodate more traffic and bring in more tolls.
sentences.zh: 这次扩建是为了让大桥能够容纳更多的交通流量并带来更多的过桥费。

sentences.en: To accomplish this, Maroon needed to buy up the land near the bridge's opening.
sentences.zh: 为了实现这一目标，马伦需要买下大桥入口附近的土地。

sentences.en: But there was one problem.
sentences.zh: 但有一个问题。

sentences.en: That land was already occupied by a vibrant residential neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 那片土地已经被一个充满活力的居民区占据了。

sentences.en: I mean, the bridge company wasn't thinking about what they were wiping out.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，大桥公司根本没有考虑他们正在摧毁什么。

sentences.en: They had tunnel vision.
sentences.zh: 他们有“隧道视野”。

sentences.en: Bridge vision, I guess, is what it should be called.
sentences.zh: 我想应该叫“大桥视野”。

sentences.en: Kathy Wendler is a Detroit native.
sentences.zh: 凯西·温德勒是底特律本地人。

sentences.en: She worked for the Southwest Detroit Business Association for decades,
sentences.zh: 她为西南底特律商业协会工作了几十年，

sentences.en: first joining in 1981, two years after the Maroons took over the bridge.
sentences.zh: 1981年首次加入，那是马伦家族接管大桥两年后。

sentences.en: Her job was community development.
sentences.zh: 她的工作是社区发展。

sentences.en: She soon realized that meant she would have to oppose the Maroons.
sentences.zh: 她很快意识到这意味着她必须反对马伦家族。

sentences.en: It was located in a community.
sentences.zh: 它坐落在一个社区里。

sentences.en: It was located in a place.
sentences.zh: 它坐落在一个地方。

sentences.en: And that place was at least as important as that bridge.
sentences.zh: 而那个地方至少和那座桥一样重要。

sentences.en: Important, and to its residents, pretty special.
sentences.zh: 很重要，而且对当地居民来说，非常特别。

sentences.en: Southwest Detroit was not some big industrial depot.
sentences.zh: 底特律西南部并不是什么大型工业仓库。

sentences.en: Far from it.
sentences.zh: 远非如此。

sentences.en: This is a closely knit neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 这是一个联系紧密的社区。

sentences.en: A lot of the Motor City is really spread out.
sentences.zh: 汽车城底特律的很多地方分布得非常广。

sentences.en: Wide boulevards meant for a lot of cars.
sentences.zh: 宽阔的林荫大道是为大量汽车设计的。

sentences.en: But Southwest, it's dense and it's accessible.
sentences.zh: 但西南区不同，那里人口稠密，交通便利。

sentences.en: It was walkable.
sentences.zh: 那是一个适合步行的社区。

sentences.en: You didn't have to have a car.
sentences.zh: 你根本不需要有车。

sentences.en: You could get groceries.
sentences.zh: 你可以去买杂货。

sentences.en: You could go to the doctor.
sentences.zh: 你可以去看医生。

sentences.en: You could get dry cleaning done.
sentences.zh: 你可以去送洗衣服。

sentences.en: It was vibrant.
sentences.zh: 那里充满活力。

sentences.en: For the folks living here, the neighborhood felt special.
sentences.zh: 对于住在这里的人们来说，这个社区感觉很特别。

sentences.en: And the Maroons and their ambitious plans quickly became everyone's business.
sentences.zh: 而马龙一家及其雄心勃勃的计划很快就成了大家关注的焦点。

sentences.en: Here's Sam Butler again, the head of a local neighborhood group.
sentences.zh: 再次请出当地社区组织负责人萨姆·巴特勒。

sentences.en: I don't think it's hyperbole to say that a lot of neighbors feel like the bridge company has historically been an existential threat to the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我认为说大桥公司在历史上一直是对该社区的生存威胁，这并不夸张。

sentences.en: Throughout the 80s, Matty Maroon bought up a lot of property to expand his bridge empire.
sentences.zh: 整个80年代，马蒂·马龙买下了大量房产，以扩张他的大桥帝国。

sentences.en: But with so much pushback against the Maroons, a showdown became inevitable.
sentences.zh: 但随着针对马伦家族的反对声浪日益高涨，一场摊牌已不可避免。

sentences.en: In January 2012, Maroon and his longtime right-hand man, Dan Stamper, were hauled before a county judge.
sentences.zh: 2012年1月，马伦和他的长期心腹丹·斯坦珀被传唤到县法官面前。

sentences.en: Fed up with their foot-dragging on the Gateway Project, the judge ordered both of them to spend one night in jail.
sentences.zh: 由于受够了他们在“门户项目”上的拖延，法官下令将两人拘留一晚。

sentences.en: Maroon was 84 years old.
sentences.zh: 当时马伦已经84岁了。

sentences.en: One of the richest and most powerful men in the city
sentences.zh: 这位城中最富有、最有权势的人之一，

sentences.en: was thrown in county lockup.
sentences.zh: 被关进了县看守所。

sentences.en: John Gallagher remembers this well.
sentences.zh: 约翰·加拉格尔对此记忆犹新。

sentences.en: It was astonishing that a guy of his stature,
sentences.zh: 令人震惊的是，像他这样地位的人，

sentences.en: I mean, a billionaire businessman,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一位亿万富翁商人，

sentences.en: would be thrown in jail for resisting, you know, a court order.
sentences.zh: 竟然会因为抗拒法庭命令而被投入监狱。

sentences.en: The stay in the pen wasn't too bad for Matty Maroon.
sentences.zh: 对于马蒂·马伦来说，这次牢狱之灾并不算太难熬。

sentences.en: He got approval to have the Detroit Athletic Club,
sentences.zh: 他获准让底特律体育俱乐部，

sentences.en: a swanky members-only venue in the city,
sentences.zh: 也就是城里一家豪华的会员制场所，

sentences.en: send over a catered dinner that night.
sentences.zh: 当晚送来了一份配餐晚餐。

sentences.en: When he got out, he had a big smile on his face.
sentences.zh: 他出来时，脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm fine.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How do you feel to be out?
sentences.zh: 出来感觉如何？

sentences.en: I love our country.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我们的国家。

sentences.en: Best country in the world.
sentences.zh: 世界上最好的国家。

sentences.en: For a long time, it seemed like the Maroons' bridge monopoly would never end.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，马伦家族对大桥的垄断似乎永远不会结束。

sentences.en: Ultimately, the only group of people with the clout and the ability to stand up to the Maroons
sentences.zh: 最终，唯一有影响力且有能力对抗马伦家族的群体，

sentences.en: was the Great White North.
sentences.zh: 是北方的大国——加拿大。

sentences.en: Yes, Canada came to the rescue to bail out America.
sentences.zh: 没错，加拿大出手相救，来为美国解围了。

sentences.en: And when Canada came swinging, the final battle over the future of the ambassador began.
sentences.zh: 当加拿大强势介入时，关于大使桥未来的终极之战便拉开了序幕。

sentences.en: Canada's top ministers actually agreed with the Maroons about something.
sentences.zh: 加拿大的高级部长们其实在一点上与马伦家族达成了共识。

sentences.en: There should be a second bridge connecting Detroit to Windsor.
sentences.zh: 底特律和温莎之间确实应该建第二座桥。

sentences.en: They just didn't want Maddie to own it.
sentences.zh: 他们只是不想让马蒂拥有它。

sentences.en: Beginning in 2004, the Canadian government made a series of proposals to build a second bridge.
sentences.zh: 从2004年开始，加拿大政府提出了一系列修建第二座桥的方案。

sentences.en: Their bridge would link up directly with the freeway,
sentences.zh: 他们的大桥将直接与高速公路相连，

sentences.en: making the trip easier for truckers and the quality of life better for the neighborhoods in Detroit.
sentences.zh: 让卡车司机的行程更轻松，也让底特律社区的生活质量得到改善。

sentences.en: It would introduce competition and it would bring back pedestrian walkways.
sentences.zh: 它将引入竞争，并恢复行人通道。

sentences.en: The ambassador had closed theirs years ago.
sentences.zh: 大使桥多年前就已经关闭了他们的行人通道。

sentences.en: A Canadian diplomat named Roy Norton was the public face of the effort.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫罗伊·诺顿的加拿大外交官成为了这项工作的公众代言人。

sentences.en: He made it clear breaking up the Maroons bridge monopoly would be no easy task.
sentences.zh: 他明确表示，打破马伦家族的大桥垄断绝非易事。

sentences.en: I confess to having had periodic visions of a Maroon-owned 18-wheeler bearing down on me
sentences.zh: 我承认，我时常会产生幻觉，梦见一辆马伦家族拥有的18轮大卡车向我冲来，

sentences.en: and forcing me off the road as I crisscrossed the state of Michigan.
sentences.zh: 在我横穿密歇根州时把我逼出路面。

sentences.en: The bottom line in Michigan, the Maroons win.
sentences.zh: 在密歇根州，底线就是：马伦家族总是赢家。

sentences.en: At least historically, that's been the case.
sentences.zh: 至少从历史上看，情况一直如此。

sentences.en: Norton called the Maroons liars and scoundrels.
sentences.zh: 诺顿称马伦家族是骗子和无赖。

sentences.en: He chastised the lawmakers who took their campaign money
sentences.zh: 他斥责那些拿了他们竞选资金的立法者，

sentences.en: and suggested the whole family should be investigated for violating antitrust laws.
sentences.zh: 并建议应该调查整个家族是否违反了反垄断法。

sentences.en: This tough talk paid off.
sentences.zh: 这种强硬的言论收到了成效。

sentences.en: In 2012, an agreement was reached.
sentences.zh: 2012年，双方达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: a second bridge would be built and controlled entirely by the Canadian government.
sentences.zh: 第二座大桥将由加拿大政府全权建造和控制。

sentences.en: It would be named the Gordie Howe Bridge in honor of the Canadian hockey star
sentences.zh: 它将被命名为戈迪·豪大桥，以纪念这位加拿大冰球明星，

sentences.en: who played most of his career with the Detroit Red Wings, a symbol of bi-national unity.
sentences.zh: 他职业生涯的大部分时间都在底特律红翼队度过，是双边团结的象征。

sentences.en: And here's the sweetener.
sentences.zh: 而且还有一个诱人的条件。

sentences.en: Canada would pay the entire cost of the new bridge.
sentences.zh: 加拿大将承担新桥的全部费用。

sentences.en: American taxpayers would pay nothing.
sentences.zh: 美国纳税人无需支付一分钱。

sentences.en: This didn't sit well with the Maroons.
sentences.zh: 这让马伦家族很不高兴。

sentences.en: Another bridge would mean they'd have to adopt competitive pricing
sentences.zh: 再建一座桥意味着他们必须采取竞争性定价，

sentences.en: and make costly improvements just to stay afloat.
sentences.zh: 并进行昂贵的升级改造才能维持生存。

sentences.en: So they pulled out all the stops to try and prevent the Gordie Howe from being built.
sentences.zh: 于是他们想尽一切办法阻止戈迪·豪大桥的建设。

sentences.en: Matty Maroon's son, Matthew, made his case to the media.
sentences.zh: 马蒂·马伦的儿子马修向媒体陈述了他的理由。

sentences.en: We've got a Michigan business that's been here for 83 years
sentences.zh: 我们是一家在密歇根州经营了83年的企业，

sentences.en: and contributed economically to the city and the state.
sentences.zh: 为这座城市和这个州做出了经济贡献。

sentences.en: The Maroons fought back with some pretty aggressive tactics.
sentences.zh: 马伦家族采取了一些相当激进的手段进行反击。

sentences.en: In 2011, when the Gordie Howe was still in the planning stage,
sentences.zh: 2011年，当戈迪·豪大桥还处于规划阶段时，

sentences.en: a bunch of yellow eviction notices went up in a neighborhood close to the proposed bridge site.
sentences.zh: 拟建大桥地点附近的社区里贴满了黄色的驱逐通知。

sentences.en: A lot of people, understandably, freaked out.
sentences.zh: 很多人理所当然地感到恐慌。

sentences.en: But the notices were fake.
sentences.zh: 但这些通知是伪造的。

sentences.en: A scare tactic meant to drum up opposition to the Gordie Howe Bridge.
sentences.zh: 这是一种旨在煽动对戈迪·豪大桥反对情绪的恐吓手段。

sentences.en: A conservative lobbying group, Americans for Prosperity, took credit for the fake eviction notices.
sentences.zh: 一个保守派游说团体“美国繁荣”承认是他们制作了这些虚假的驱逐通知。

sentences.en: Then there was the ballot box.
sentences.zh: 接着是投票箱之争。

sentences.en: Matty Maroon spent more than $30 million to get an amendment passed by Michigan voters called Proposal 6.
sentences.zh: 马蒂·马伦花费了超过3000万美元，试图让密歇根州选民通过一项名为“提案6”的修正案。

sentences.en: Proposal 6 would make all future bridge projects subject to a referendum by both state and local voters.
sentences.zh: “提案6”规定，未来所有大桥项目都必须经过州和地方选民的公投。

sentences.en: The whole thing was designed to make approval for projects like the Gordie Howe Bridge much more difficult.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为了让像戈迪·豪大桥这样的项目更难获得批准。

sentences.en: Groups supported by Maddie Maroon ran ads implying that voters somehow would have to pay for the Gordie Howe Bridge.
sentences.zh: 由马蒂·马伦支持的团体投放广告，暗示选民可能不得不为戈迪·豪大桥买单。

sentences.en: And that Proposal 6 would stop that from happening.
sentences.zh: 而“提案6”可以阻止这种情况发生。

sentences.en: Here's why Michigan voters are voting yes on Proposal 6.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么密歇根州选民要投票支持“提案6”。

sentences.en: There's no such thing as a free bridge.
sentences.zh: 天下没有免费的大桥。

sentences.en: There's no such thing as a free bridge.
sentences.zh: 天下没有免费的大桥。

sentences.en: Someone pays.
sentences.zh: 总有人要买单。

sentences.en: I don't care who owns the bridge.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎谁拥有这座桥。

sentences.en: All I care about is paying for a new one without even being asked.
sentences.zh: 我只在乎在没被征求意见的情况下，就要为新桥掏钱。

sentences.en: Yes means we have the power.
sentences.zh: 投赞成票意味着我们掌握权力。

sentences.en: No means we give it away to the politicians.
sentences.zh: 投反对票意味着我们把权力拱手让给了政客。

sentences.en: They called their campaign, The People Should Decide.
sentences.zh: 他们把自己的竞选活动称为“人民应该决定”。

sentences.en: Ultimately, the bridge amendment failed, with 60% of voters rejecting it.
sentences.zh: 最终，这项大桥修正案以失败告终，60%的选民投了反对票。

sentences.en: Still, the Maroon family wouldn't go down without a fight.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，马伦家族还是不肯轻易认输。

sentences.en: The Maroons took the new bridge authority to court,
sentences.zh: 马伦家族将新大桥管理局告上法庭，

sentences.en: filing lawsuit after lawsuit to delay its construction,
sentences.zh: 接二连三地提起诉讼以拖延施工，

sentences.en: and appealing all the way to the state Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 并一路申诉到了州最高法院。

sentences.en: Eventually, they ran out of legal avenues.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们的法律手段用尽了。

sentences.en: But they were able to drag things out for six years.
sentences.zh: 但他们还是成功地将事情拖延了六年。

sentences.en: In 2018, during President Trump's first term in office,
sentences.zh: 2018年，在特朗普总统的第一任期内，

sentences.en: the Canadian bridge was due to finally begin construction.
sentences.zh: 这座加拿大大桥终于要开始动工了。

sentences.en: So Matty Maroon tried a Hail Mary to save his family's monopoly.
sentences.zh: 于是马蒂·马伦孤注一掷，试图挽救他家族的垄断地位。

sentences.en: Dear Mr. President, there are two grand new bridges being proposed in Detroit between
sentences.zh: 亲爱的总统先生，底特律正在提议修建两座宏伟的新桥，连接

sentences.en: America and Canada.
sentences.zh: 美国和加拿大。

sentences.en: One is American-made, American-owned.
sentences.zh: 一座是美国制造，美国拥有。

sentences.en: It uses American-made steel,
sentences.zh: 它使用美国制造的钢材，

sentences.en: 5,000 American workers.
sentences.zh: 雇佣5000名美国工人。

sentences.en: The other would be Canadian-made, Canadian-owned, Canadian workers.
sentences.zh: 另一座将是加拿大制造，加拿大拥有，使用加拿大工人。

sentences.en: Who knows who would make the steel?
sentences.zh: 谁知道钢材会是谁制造的呢？

sentences.en: This ad ran on Fox News in the hopes that Trump would see it
sentences.zh: 这则广告在福克斯新闻频道播出，希望特朗普能看到它，

sentences.en: and intervene.
sentences.zh: 并进行干预。

sentences.en: Given that the president was known to watch Fox News constantly,
sentences.zh: 鉴于总统以经常观看福克斯新闻而闻名，

sentences.en: it wasn't a bad plan.
sentences.zh: 这倒不是个坏主意。

sentences.en: In this ad, the Maroons tried to paint their idea for a bridge project
sentences.zh: 在这则广告中，马伦家族试图将他们的大桥项目构想，

sentences.en: as a patriotic alternative.
sentences.zh: 描绘成一种爱国主义的选择。

sentences.en: Choose American.
sentences.zh: 选择美国制造。

sentences.en: Thank you, sir.
sentences.zh: 谢谢您，先生。

sentences.en: Signed, America.
sentences.zh: 签名：美国。

sentences.en: Despite all this, let's just call it lobbying, Trump never intervened.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我们姑且称之为游说吧，特朗普从未干预。

sentences.en: And the Gordie Howe
sentences.zh: 而戈迪·豪

sentences.en: bridge finally broke ground that June.
sentences.zh: 大桥最终在那年六月破土动工。

sentences.en: This fall, the Gordie Howe Bridge is set to open.
sentences.zh: 今年秋天，戈迪·豪大桥即将开通。

sentences.en: It's a
sentences.zh: 它是

sentences.en: brand new symbol of Canadian-American friendship, at a moment when relations between the two countries
sentences.zh: 加美友谊的全新象征，而此时两国及其领导人之间的关系，

sentences.en: and their leaders are at their lowest point since the War of 1812, when British troops burned down
sentences.zh: 正处于自1812年战争以来的最低点，当时英军烧毁了

sentences.en: the White House.
sentences.zh: 白宫。

sentences.en: As another Canadian once said, isn't it ironic?
sentences.zh: 正如另一位加拿大人曾经说过的，这难道不讽刺吗？

sentences.en: Since the loss of the bridge
sentences.zh: 自从失去了大桥

sentences.en: monopoly, the Maroons have taken a step back.
sentences.zh: 垄断地位后，马伦家族退居幕后。

sentences.en: The same month the Gordie Howe Bridge began
sentences.zh: 就在戈迪·豪大桥于2018年开始

sentences.en: construction in 2018, the family sold Michigan Central to the Ford Motor Company for $90 million.
sentences.zh: 施工的同一个月，该家族以9000万美元的价格将密歇根中央车站卖给了福特汽车公司。

sentences.en: In 2020, Matty Maroon died at the age of 93 from heart failure.
sentences.zh: 2020年，马蒂·马伦因心力衰竭去世，享年93岁。

sentences.en: He had already transferred control
sentences.zh: 他早已将家族企业的控制权，

sentences.en: of the family's enterprises, including the bridge, to his son Matthew.
sentences.zh: 包括大桥在内，移交给了他的儿子马修。

sentences.en: Since then, the Maroons have
sentences.zh: 从那以后，马伦家族

sentences.en: continued their blockbusting in new areas of the city, connected to other business ventures.
sentences.zh: 继续在城市的新区域进行房地产开发，并与其他商业项目挂钩。

sentences.en: But the tone and the family's tactics have softened.
sentences.zh: 但家族的基调和策略已经变得温和了。

sentences.en: They've held public events.
sentences.zh: 他们举办了公开活动。

sentences.en: They reached a community agreement with Southwest Detroit
sentences.zh: 他们与底特律西南区达成了社区协议，

sentences.en: that clearly defines where they can build and where they can't.
sentences.zh: 明确规定了他们可以在哪里建设，哪里不能。

sentences.en: And earlier this summer, they tore down the bridge to nowhere.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天早些时候，他们拆除了那座“通往虚无之桥”。

sentences.en: And Michigan Central, oh boy, Ford Motor Company spent nearly a billion dollars renovating it
sentences.zh: 至于密歇根中央车站，天哪，福特汽车公司花了近十亿美元对其进行翻新，

sentences.en: and turned it into a tech hub and tourist destination with a luxury hotel on the way.
sentences.zh: 将其改造成了一个科技中心和旅游目的地，并计划开设一家豪华酒店。

sentences.en: They turned the whole project into a major community effort.
sentences.zh: 他们把整个项目变成了一项重大的社区工程。

sentences.en: And they even welcomed the station's looters to return the historic stuff they stole, no questions asked.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至欢迎车站的掠夺者归还他们偷走的文物，并承诺既往不咎。

sentences.en: And many did.
sentences.zh: 许多人确实归还了。

sentences.en: When the building reopened last year, it included a public exhibit of all that repatriated loot.
sentences.zh: 去年大楼重新开放时，里面还专门设立了一个公共展览，展示所有追回的赃物。

sentences.en: A reopening concert brought out Detroit's finest musicians, like Eminem, Diana Ross, and Jack White.
sentences.zh: 重开音乐会请来了底特律最优秀的音乐家，如阿姆、戴安娜·罗斯和杰克·怀特。

sentences.en: Between the new bridge and Michigan Central reopening,
sentences.zh: 随着新大桥的建成和密歇根中央车站的重新开放，

sentences.en: there are a lot of reasons for Detroiters to celebrate the city right now.
sentences.zh: 底特律人现在有很多理由为这座城市庆祝。

sentences.en: In 2013, Detroit filed the largest municipal bankruptcy in American history.
sentences.zh: 2013年，底特律申请了美国历史上规模最大的市政破产。

sentences.en: But from this embarrassing failure, things started looking up.
sentences.zh: 但从这次尴尬的失败中，情况开始好转。

sentences.en: New people and businesses have moved in,
sentences.zh: 新的人口和企业迁入，

sentences.en: and developers reshaped the city at lightning speed.
sentences.zh: 开发商以闪电般的速度重塑了这座城市。

sentences.en: The new bridge has been part of that excitement.
sentences.zh: 新大桥的建设也是这股热潮的一部分。

sentences.en: Here's John Gallagher.
sentences.zh: 下面请听约翰·加拉格尔的报道。

sentences.en: There's a generational change where some younger people came in.
sentences.zh: 这里出现了一代人的更替，一些年轻人搬了进来。

sentences.en: Some people who didn't have the same negative image of the city
sentences.zh: 有些人对这座城市并没有那种负面印象，

sentences.en: that maybe their parents had had or something.
sentences.zh: 不像他们的父母那辈人可能有的那种印象。

sentences.en: And the city just began to turn around.
sentences.zh: 城市就这样开始好转了。

sentences.en: And, you know, by 2015, 2020, it was pretty apparent
sentences.zh: 你知道，到了2015年、2020年，很明显，

sentences.en: that a lot of great stuff was happening.
sentences.zh: 很多了不起的事情正在发生。

sentences.en: It's hard not to see the shift in attitudes around Detroit.
sentences.zh: 很难不注意到底特律周边态度的转变。

sentences.en: When I interviewed Kathy Wendler at a Michigan welcome center,
sentences.zh: 当我在密歇根州的一个欢迎中心采访凯西·温德勒时，

sentences.en: she excitedly pointed through the window to the sidewalk outside,
sentences.zh: 她兴奋地指着窗外的行人路，

sentences.en: not to the Ambassador Bridge, but to something else.
sentences.zh: 指的不是大使桥，而是其他东西。

sentences.en: I don't know if they just caught that couple with the two kids walking by.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们是否刚好拍到了那对带着两个孩子走过的夫妇。

sentences.en: But at one point, this neighborhood would have never been a place where a family moved in.
